metadata.description: The jev-browser-test skill as a single-skill plugin: SKILL.md at the repository root.

plugins.name: jev-browser-test
plugins.description: Goal-driven end-to-end browser testing: Claude writes the spec and judges the result, TypeSafe's Jev picks every click from a numbered element table (one ~0.3 s request per decision), Playwright executes. Specs with declared outcomes, a verdict with the page's own line as evidence, suites with a computed flaky verdict.
